dict.string: Minnas records the other side of your calls — the audio your Mac plays — so it can transcribe them. No audio, transcript or personal data leaves this Mac unless you turn on cloud transcription.
Minnas reads your upcoming meetings so it can offer to record the ones with a Zoom, Meet or Teams link, and name each transcript after its meeting.

Minnas records your microphone so it can transcribe what you say during meetings. Recordings are kept on this Mac for the retention period you choose, so they can be re-transcribed; audio leaves this Mac only if you turn on cloud transcription.
